payload.core_mechanism_summary: Maintain array m[i] = minimal r such that s[i..r] contains a valid triple, by iterating i backwards and greedily shrinking r via direct triple checks, achieving amortized O(n).
payload.rationale: The solution uses a reverse scan with a shrinking right bound (two pointers) and a while-loop that checks triples starting at i. The inner loop runs in total O(n) because m[i] only decreases, matching the amortized_two_pointers pattern.
